Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Primary unit
From the bounded article to the persistent research programme and its versioned living book
Temporal model
From publication as a terminal event to a live branch with frozen annual or biennial editions
Internal structure
From prose with attachments to claims evidence data software decisions provenance contributions and policies
Reader experience
From compulsory linear reading to adaptive routes grounded questions tutorials simulations and audiovisual explanations
Peer review
From reconstructing context manually to inspecting claim evidence maps and controlled review capsules
Transparency
From either sparse disclosure or indiscriminate repository dumps to selective epistemic disclosure
Credit
From author order and paper counts to qualitative portfolios backed by contribution records
Project reporting
From repeatedly rewritten documents to authorised projections of maintained knowledge
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Atomic substrate
Claims evidence experiments data software literature relations contributions versions and access policies receive independent identities
Monographic interface
The programme accepts responsibility for a coherent explanation of why those objects matter and how they relate
Article
A compact release note priority record or certification event attached to a larger research world
Generated views
Briefings papers funder reports tutorials videos simulations and regulatory views compiled from a common source
Assurance
Traceability connects each compression or expansion to stable source units and a declared edition
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Private research workspace
Optimised for discovery It contains raw work failed paths internal deliberation protected data code branches partner material and provisional agent outputs
Controlled evidence vault
Optimised for restricted verification It holds evidence required for audit confidential review remote execution legal checks and future reinterpretation
Public living research book
Optimised for explanation and accountability It contains the coherent argument open evidence disclosed limitations provenance and public interfaces
Boundary rule
Objects move or are transformed across zones only under explicit privacy security licensing contractual and IP policies
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Public reader
Receives the canonical book open artefacts assurance labels and an explanation of restricted dependencies
Assigned reviewer
Receives a scoped capsule containing the material needed for a defined methodological domain privacy software or IP review
Independent auditor
May inspect broader protected evidence release procedures access logs or attestations under a separate mandate
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Project team
Retains the full exploratory workspace subject to internal governance and retention limits
Prohibited inference
No role receives unrestricted access merely because more information exists access follows purpose and necessity
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Journals
Certify claim sets edition deltas adversarial reviews and community significance rather than merely distribute text
Publishers
Provide editorial integration secure review rights management accessibility provenance and interface quality under portable standards
Libraries
Preserve frozen editions manifests executable components access conditions and independent reading interfaces
Universities
Operate programme environments contribution records secure data services and qualitative career assessment
Funders
Review evidence and objective evolution pay for maintenance and review and limit access to contractually justified views
Professional societies
Define domain specific evidence review and publication profiles
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Regulators and ethics bodies
Inspect authorised compliance and evidence views derived from the same canonical source
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Cathedral of fluent emptiness
Expose the contribution delta claim status and evidence independently of length and polish
Dimension
Implication for the living research book
Coherent false world
Preserve contradictory evidence branches external review and independent retrieval
Scientific monoculture
Measure source concentration fund exploratory branches and maintain plural interfaces and model families
Selective deception
Publish the disclosure topology permit challenges to restrictions and lower assurance when evidence remains inaccessible
Surveillance
Separate scholarly contribution records from behavioural telemetry and impose retention access and labour protections
Platform capture
Require open standards exportability institutional hosting and library preservation
Maintenance collapse
Define release retirement archival migration and funding responsibilities
Metric migration
Use structured evidence to support qualitative judgment rather than creating new automatic counts
